title: Fullmag recent-project index
description: Host-side cache that backs the start screen's recent list. It is derived state: every field can be rebuilt by rescanning the configured project locations, so a corrupt or missing index must never block creating or opening a project. Written by the Tauri host, read by the control-room renderer. Location: %APPDATA%/Fullmag/recent-index.json (Windows), ~/.config/fullmag/recent-index.json (Linux), ~/Library/Application Support/Fullmag/recent-index.json (macOS).

format_version.description: Index format, independent of the .fms archive schema_version. Bump on any breaking change; an unreadable or newer index is discarded and rebuilt.

scanned_locations.description: Roots walked during the last rebuild. Shown in Settings → Projects → Scanned locations.

reachable.description: False for a network share that was offline during the scan. Entries under an unreachable root keep their cached metadata and are shown with status "missing" rather than being dropped.

continue.description: The interrupted run offered by the Continue card. Absent when no run was checkpointed. At most one; a second interrupted run appears in the list with status "running" instead.

project_id.description: Stable identity, carried in the .fms manifest. Survives renames and moves; the list de-duplicates on it.

path.description: Absolute host path of the .fms archive. Never shown unabbreviated in a 72 px column — the UI ellipsises from the left so the file name stays readable.

status.description: Drives the status pill. "missing" is set by the host when the path no longer resolves; "migrate" when manifest_schema_version < the app's supported version.

size_bytes.description: Total on disk: the .fms archive plus its results directory. The archive alone is capped at 64 MB by the host (MAX_PROJECT_ARCHIVE_BYTES), so a multi-gigabyte figure here is almost entirely results. Computed by the scanner; summary.output_bytes carries the results directory on its own.

revision.description: Mirrors ProjectDocumentResource.revision at the time of the last close.

mode_reason.description: Why the project opens read-only — a network share, a shipped benchmark, a locked file. Shown verbatim in the inspector banner.

thumbnail.description: Preview of the last result, 16:10. Relative to the index file, or a data URI for a thumbnail small enough to inline. Absent for a project that has never been run.

last_error.description: One sentence from the last failed run, shown in the inspector banner. Cleared on the next successful run.

summary.description: Denormalised model facts so the inspector can render without opening the archive. Refreshed on close; treated as a hint, never as truth — opening the project re-reads the manifest.

eta_seconds.description: Estimated remaining wall-clock. Null when the estimate is not yet meaningful — the UI then omits the ETA rather than showing a guess.

resumable.description: False when the checkpoint cannot be resumed on this machine (missing device, incompatible build). The Continue card then offers Open and Discard only, and says why.

discretisation.description: "512 × 512 × 8" for FDM, "42 180 tetrahedra" for FEM. Pre-formatted by the host so the renderer does not branch on solver kind.
